sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the petitioner and perusal of record, it transpires, at present,
adjudication order has been passed against the petitioner dated 30.04.2023.
The same is appealable under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. In face of factual disputes involved, interference claimed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is declined.

3. Present writ petition is accordingly disposed of, leaving it open to the petitioner to avail his statutory remedy in accordance with law.
